_why: O-Strata's getPresetListWithCategories returns a JSON STRING (Source/PluginEditor.cpp), not the juce::var object O-Bells returns. The generic stub defaults to the object because a page that JSON.parses one catches and degrades, while a page that Object.keys a string renders one bogus category per character. This file supplies Strata's real shape so its page boots without a console error. getEmbeddedTuningList is here for the same reason the inherited O-Prism fixture carried it: the generic stub returns an EMPTY list, and a harness that cannot reach a state certifies nothing about it (the O-MicrotonalSampler lesson) - with it empty, the whole Tuning Library panel was never rendered and therefore never measured by check-ui-labels. The values below are the shape a loaded plugin carries. TEST FIXTURE ONLY - never shipped, never embedded. Stage 1 fork: the four wavetable-library natives this fixture used to stub left with the library; the generic stub's null for getActiveOscFrame is tolerated by WavetableDisplay.fetchAndDraw's `if (result)` branch.
